item.description: Steady progress is being made on the Airport Master Plan Update. Working Paper No. 2 has been completed. This paper focuses primarily on the Facility Assessment and Requirements chapter, offering a detailed evaluation of the airport’s facility needs across a 20-year planning horizon. item.description: As provided in Section 212.055(3), Florida Statutes, Florida counties having a total population of 50,000 or less on April 1, 1992, are eligible to levy the Small County Surtax at the rate of 0.5 or 1 percent. Flagler County is one of thirty-one counties eligible to levy the Small County Surtax, but the only one of the thirty-one to levy the tax at 0.5 percent; the remaining thirty counties levy the tax at the full 1 percent. Regular updates are necessary to reflect changes in federal and state requirements, incorporate new policies that promote transparency and accountability, and streamline processes for efficiency. item.description: Section 197.233, Florida Statutes, permits the County Commission, upon request by the Tax Collector and by majority vote, to order the tax roll to be extended while the Value Adjustment Board completes its hearings. The Honorable Shelly Edmonson, Flagler County Tax Collector, has made such request. By extending the tax roll, the Property Appraiser and Tax Collector will be able to proceed to mail out tax notices in a timely manner; taxing authorities will be able to collect revenue beginning November 1st; and taxpayers will have the opportunity to pay their taxes during each of the four discount periods allowed by law. The same step has been taken in Flagler County each year since 2006.
